properties.name: Sea on today's land: head of the Persian Gulf
properties.description: Map 5000 (items 5000bc-16 a, 5000bc-4; 21.11.2026): the head of the Gulf c. 7000 cal BP — Iran after Heyvaert & Baeteman 2007 (fig. 11b: the coast of c. 7500 and 5000 cal BP), Iraq after Sanlaville & Dalongeville 2005 (fig. 2: the assumed maximum of the transgression through Nasiriya and Amara); approximate. Erased from the land only. Written by tools/sea-inland.py.
